$comment: Which capcutctl these skills are written against.
cli-contract.json is a verbatim copy of docs/cli-contract.json from the CLI repository
at the commit named below. Refresh both together, never one alone:
then update contractSyncedFrom and run scripts/validate.py.
undocumentedCommands exempts a contract command from the coverage check, which
otherwise requires every command and subcommand the CLI publishes to be written down
in some skill. Map each one to the reason it is not for agents to read. The list is
checked itself: an entry that is not a real command, or names a command that is in
fact documented, is a finding — so it cannot rot into a place findings go to die.
